title: Jeremiah's Prayer for Vengeance Against His Enemies
description: The people plot against Jeremiah and seek to harm him with their words. Jeremiah asks the Lord to hear him, reminding God how he has spoken well on their behalf and turned away God's anger. He prays that famine, sword, and plague may strike their families as retribution, and that God will not forgive their guilt but act against them on the day of wrath.
